title: Austin's Next Fiscal Year Budget Revealed
summary:
*   Austin city officials received the proposed 1988-89 Operating Budget and Capital Improvements plan.
*   The Acting City Manager and Budget Director discussed key aspects of the financial plan for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   A timeline for upcoming budget discussions and decisions was presented to the city leaders.
*   City staff were publicly recognized and thanked for their extensive work on the budget documents.
